stores.name: Coles Caloundra

stores.name: Coles Peregian Springs

stores.name: ALDI Buderim
stores.address: Buderim Central Shopping Centre, 44 Main St, Buderim QLD 4556

stores.name: ALDI Caloundra
stores.address: ALDI Caloundra, 7 Baldwin St, Caloundra QLD 4551
stores.notes: Budget-friendly supermarket for Caloundra families. Bring or buy bags.

stores.name: IGA Alexandra Headland
stores.address: Alexandra Headland Shopping Centre, 15-17 Mari St, Alexandra Headland QLD 4572
stores.notes: Convenient local IGA between Maroochydore and Mooloolaba. Great for quick top-ups and local products.
